{"predictors": [{"name": "Customer Concentration Fragility", "construction": "From firm 10-K disclosures under SFAS 131, identify major customers accounting for >10% of revenue. Compute a Herfindahl index of disclosed customer revenue shares. Rank firms cross-sectionally each June on this concentration index, updated annually.", "rationale": "Firms dependent on a few large customers bear undiversified cash-flow risk from customer bargaining power and potential loss, which is not fully priced and commands a risk premium.", "higher_returns_for": "high customer concentration (high Herfindahl)"},
{"name": "Inventory-Sales Momentum Divergence", "construction": "Compute year-over-year growth in inventory (Compustat INVT) minus year-over-year growth in sales (SALE) using the most recent quarterly data. Rank firms each month on this divergence.", "rationale": "Inventory building faster than sales signals demand overestimation by management and impending markdowns, so high-divergence firms subsequently underperform.", "higher_returns_for": "low inventory-sales divergence (inventory growing slower than sales)"},
{"name": "Order Flow Roundness Clustering", "construction": "Using TAQ intraday trade data over the prior month, compute the fraction of a stock's share volume executed in round-lot sizes that are multiples of 1000 shares. Rank stocks cross-sectionally each month.", "rationale": "A high fraction of round-number institutional block trades proxies for informed institutional accumulation, predicting positive future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high fraction of large round-lot volume"},
{"name": "Analyst Forecast Dispersion Acceleration", "construction": "From I/B/E/S, compute the monthly change in the standard deviation of analyst EPS forecasts scaled by price (change in dispersion). Rank firms on the two-month acceleration in forecast dispersion.", "rationale": "Rising disagreement combined with short-sale constraints (Miller effect) leads to overpricing that reverses, so accelerating dispersion predicts lower returns.", "higher_returns_for": "declining or low dispersion acceleration"},
{"name": "Capex Timing Concentration", "construction": "Using quarterly Compustat capital expenditures (CAPXY differenced), compute the coefficient of variation of the firm's four quarterly capex figures over the trailing year. Rank firms on this seasonality/lumpiness measure.", "rationale": "Lumpy, poorly-timed investment spikes reflect agency-driven or reactive capital allocation that destroys value, predicting lower future returns.", "higher_returns_for": "smooth (low coefficient of variation) capex"},
{"name": "Deferred Revenue Growth", "construction": "Compute year-over-year growth in the deferred revenue liability (Compustat DRC plus DRLT) scaled by total assets. Rank firms annually each June.", "rationale": "Growing deferred revenue reflects prepaid customer commitments and future recognized sales that the market underweights relative to reported earnings, predicting higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high deferred revenue growth"},
{"name": "Working Capital Efficiency Trend", "construction": "Compute the cash conversion cycle (days inventory + days receivables - days payables) using Compustat INVT, RECT, AP, COGS, SALE, and take the change over the trailing two years. Rank firms on the improvement (decrease) in the cycle.", "rationale": "Firms shortening their cash conversion cycle are improving operational efficiency and liquidity generation ahead of market recognition, predicting higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "large improvement (decrease) in cash conversion cycle"},
{"name": "Geographic Revenue Diffusion", "construction": "From segment disclosures in 10-Ks, count the number of distinct geographic segments and compute a diversification Herfindahl of foreign vs domestic revenue. Rank firms on foreign revenue share change year-over-year.", "rationale": "Rising foreign revenue share exposes firms to underpriced currency and macro risks and demand shifts, commanding a return premium not captured by domestic beta.", "higher_returns_for": "high foreign revenue share"},
{"name": "Short-Interest Velocity", "construction": "Using semi-monthly short interest data from exchanges, compute the change in shares-short scaled by shares outstanding over the most recent two settlement periods (the velocity of short accumulation). Rank stocks each month.", "rationale": "Rapid new short accumulation reflects informed negative sentiment that predicts subsequent underperformance beyond the level of short interest.", "higher_returns_for": "low or negative short-interest velocity"},
{"name": "Employee Productivity Shock", "construction": "Compute sales per employee (Compustat SALE / EMP) and take the year-over-year growth, then subindustry-adjust by subtracting the median growth of the firm's 3-digit SIC peers. Rank firms annually each June.", "rationale": "Above-peer improvement in labor productivity signals durable operational quality and margin expansion that the market is slow to incorporate, predicting higher returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high peer-adjusted productivity growth"}]}
